findings.title: Mandatory Accepted ACK is unavailable for the registered SOL market IOC path
findings.cause: rights_v2_evidence requires a native_acks row for every SOL_ADD. That table is populated only by typed OrderAccepted/OrderUpdated frames. Exact ce7 SOL_ADD uses MARKET IOC (strategy wave_overlay.py2068), and registered stock add_venue preserves Nautilus1.231 default use_market_order_acks=False (engine.pyx526). Native market processing emits Accepted only conditionally (5350–5354), then fills. Thus genuine Submitted→Filled market IOC orders can never satisfy this mandatory ACK lookup. The unit positive fixture invents a separate native_acks row and does not exercise the registered no-market-ACK event path. This knowingly leaves the replay rights UNKNOWN despite complete real fill/history evidence.
findings.required_fix: For the source-pinned MARKET IOC path, bind actual native fill/terminal history, CID/OID/strategy/instrument/side/quantity and genuine event IDs without requiring the optional OrderAccepted. Unfilled terminal orders also need their real terminal ownership disposition. Never count INITIALIZED/submission as accepted exposure, and do not weaken actual resting BTC TP ACK requirements. Add a stdlib fact-chain regression for actual no-Accepted market execution.

findings.title: Touch proof changes legacy latch semantics and includes future same-timestamp entry fills
findings.cause: rights_guarded_touch requires a BTC crossing quote at exactly the activation row timestamp (282,291). Original _activate_selective_sol_rights latches an earned crossing first (source1623–1627); activation can occur at a later paired-ready quote without crossing again (1628–1637). Requiring simultaneous cross+activation adds a new oldSOL eligibility rule. In addition, earned entry sums every fill with ns<=activation_ns (289), including fills later in the same native timestamp than the activation snapshot, then compares against activation.confirmed_native_entry_qty. Existing source queue/fill ordering permits several partial entry/fill callbacks at one timestamp; future same-ns fills are not evidence of the earlier source state. Both paths can label faithful original-policy execution missing/invalid and waste the sole reserve.
findings.required_fix: Prove an actual earned latch-cross event and the subsequent guarded activation as separate causally ordered events. Bind the activation session/right-decision and confirmed entry to real before/after callback or quote frame sequence; exclude later same-ns fills. Preserve original late-entry/latch behavior, without inventing a new cross-at-activation rule. Add prior-touch/later-ready and same-timestamp later-entry negatives.
